description: Reads product copy and code comments out of source files, such as package descriptions, installer strings, cask notes and doc comments. Checks only: it never writes a source file back.
author: Neokapi <hello@neokapi.dev>

formats.name: sourcecode
formats.description: Product copy held in source files, such as package descriptions and installer notes.

canary.name: a shell comment with a doubled word, below a ShellCheck directive and above a string holding a comment marker
a C# documentation comment with a doubled word, below a ReSharper directive and above a string holding a comment marker
a CSS comment with a doubled word, below a stylelint directive and above a string holding a comment marker
a Javadoc comment with a doubled word, below an inspection suppression and above a string holding a comment marker
a JavaScript doc comment with a doubled word, below a shebang and above a template literal holding a comment marker
a Python comment with a doubled word, below a directive and above a string holding a comment marker
a Rust doc comment with a doubled word, below a licence tag and above a string holding a comment marker
a TSX doc comment with a doubled word, above JSX text holding a comment marker
a TypeScript doc comment with a doubled word, below a directive and above a string holding a comment marker
